result.markdown:
For a Canberra mid-market business looking to implement **Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents and practical workflow automation**, I’d start with specialists who can move beyond AI strategy and deliver working automations integrated with existing business systems.

My shortlist separates Microsoft-first consultancies from broader AI automation firms. The key distinction is whether you want agents built natively in the Microsoft ecosystem, or the flexibility to automate processes across multiple platforms.

## How I would shortlist them

| Your main requirement | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Copilot Studio agents and Power Platform expertise | FutureAbility |
| Canberra-based workflow automation | ReSimplify |
| Microsoft 365 readiness, security and ongoing support | I.T.S Canberra |
| Sensitive data and strict governance | Frontrow Technology |
| ERP integration and complex business processes | Eagle360 |
| Use-case discovery and practical AI adoption | Think Technology Australia |


These are research-based matches, not a verified ranking of delivery quality. FutureAbility is particularly relevant to your stated mid-market focus; the Canberra firms are worth assessing for local delivery and support.

## What to ask before engaging

Request a short discovery session and ask each candidate to demonstrate\:

- **A live Copilot Studio agent** connected to business data and able to complete a real business task.
- **A complete workflow**, including Power Automate, exception handling, approvals and integration with your existing systems.
- **Security and governance controls**, including permissions, auditability, data handling and human oversight.
- **A measurable business case\:** expected hours saved, implementation cost, licensing costs and ongoing support.
- **A reference project** for a business of similar size and complexity.

I would initially seek proposals for one bounded workflow, such as processing incoming enquiries, extracting information from documents, automating internal approvals or answering staff questions from approved company knowledge.
